subject: Post-demo security follow-up — recommended path for HelixPay compliance review
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@helixpay.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Jul 2026 18:22:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo security follow-up — recommended path for HelixPay compliance review

Hi Olivia — thanks again for taking the demo today. Quick recap and a proposed next step so we can move the questionnaire & evidence work forward without surprises: 

Summary of what we heard on the call
- HelixPay needs vendor security validation for payments product: SOC 2 (Type 2 preferred) + HIPAA scoping for any PHI flows.
- EU customer data needs to remain in EU regions when HelixPay is acting as a data processor.
- Your procurement team prefers a short audit window (2–3 weeks) for the initial evidence review.

Proposed path (recommended)
1) Start with a CAIQ prefill to cover architecture and controls (fast, maps well to cloud control expectations).
2) In parallel, provide our SOC 2 Type 2 summary + a mapped evidence index that ties SOC controls to your HelixPay assessment fields.
3) For HIPAA in-scope items, we will add the HIPAA-specific annex (short custom mapping) to the prefill so you don’t need a full custom questionnaire initially.

Clarifying questions we need from you to scope correctly
- Can you confirm whether HelixPay will treat Redwood as a processor (we assume yes) and whether Business Associate Agreement (BAA) language is required for all flows or only specific product modules?
- Do you need EU data residency for all customer data or only for EU-originating end users?
- Is encryption at-rest/in-transit detail required at artifact level (i.e., key management descriptions + KMS screenshots) or high-level statements suffice at first pass?
- Any preferred evidence delivery mechanism? (direct Drive links, DocuSign evidence exchange, or shared S3)

If that approach looks OK, I’ll kick off the CAIQ prefill and have Marcus/kim work the mapping and diagrams — we can target a 10-business-day turnaround for the prefill & SOC2 summary. If you need a faster window, tell us your hard date and we’ll prioritize.

Next step options
- Option A (recommended): We start the CAIQ prefill today and deliver SOC2 summary + mapping within 10 business days.
- Option B: If you prefer SIG/SIG-lite only, call that out and we’ll choose that path instead (timeline similar).

Happy to schedule a 30-minute handoff meeting with your security leads to confirm scope.

Thanks,
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123
Redwood Inference

Attachments: none in this message
From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@helixpay.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: security@helixpay.com
Date: Fri, 17 Jul 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo security follow-up — recommended path for HelixPay compliance review

Sofia — great summary, thanks. A few clarifications from our side so you can scope the prefill correctly: 

Answers to questions
- Processor vs Controller: HelixPay will treat Redwood as a processor for payment routing metadata. We will need a BAA for product flows that touch PHI; otherwise a standard DPA is fine.
- EU residency: Required for EU-originating customer personal data only (not necessarily logs/telemetry).
- Evidence detail: Start with high-level statements plus the SOC 2 summary & snapshot artifacts (we will ask for deeper artifacts only if gaps appear). Key management screenshots are helpful but not required up front — a KMS architecture diagram is sufficient for initial review.
- Delivery mechanism: Drive link preferred (read-only). We will catalogue artifacts on our side.

Other constraints
- Timeline: Procurement has a target of 2026-08-01 for vendor sign-off. Can you meet that given your proposed 10-business-day window?
- Questionnaires: We have a HelixPay Vendor Assessment v2 (attached) that we may ask you to map to — if you can do a CAIQ prefill + a HelixPay mapping table that would be ideal.
- Communication: can we have a short-lived Slack channel (or a dedicated thread) for quick Q&A during the evidence review? Procurement prefers Slack for fast clarifications.

I’m attaching our HelixPay Vendor Assessment v2 (for mapping) and marking procurement & security as recipients. If you can send your SOC 2 summary + a network diagram and dataflow matrix, we’ll start our internal validation.

Thanks — Olivia
Olivia Chen
Head of Vendor Risk | HelixPay
olivia.chen@helixpay.com | +1 212-555-0199

Owners & immediate tasks
- Marcus (me): Pull the SOC 2 Type 2 summary and the SOC control-to-HelixPay-assessment mapping template. I’ll also export the control evidence index from our compliance repo. Target: 2026-07-21 EOD.
- Kimberly: Create an updated network architecture diagram (PDF) and a concise data flow matrix that highlights PHI flows and EU-residency boundaries. Target: 2026-07-20 EOD.
- Sofia: Start CAIQ prefill and draft a short mapping table from CAIQ -> HelixPay vendor assessment. Also set up a temporary slack channel and propose times for a 30-min handoff meeting. Target: initial prefill draft by 2026-07-23.

Notes / Constraints
- We should confirm BAA language with legal before committing to HIPAA-specific artifacts. I’ll reach out to Legal and add them to the thread if needed.
- If procurement needs the 2026-08-01 hard sign-off, we should prioritize the SOC2 summary and mapping first, then follow with deeper artifacts as a second tranche.

Kimberly / Sofia — acknowledge if those targets look reasonable or if any blocker exists.

Thanks,

- Proposed 30-min handoff slots: Tue 2026-07-20 09:30–10:00 PT or Wed 2026-07-21 15:00–15:30 PT. Please ping which works for procurement/security.

1) You and your security team do an initial intake of the SOC2 summary + prefill (we expect clarifying Qs).
2) We iterate on the mapping table; Kimberley will update diagrams if you request deeper artifacts.
3) Legal & procurement finalize DPA/BAA language — Marcus to follow up with legal and share a Drafter DPA by 2026-07-22.

If you want the evidence delivered via DocuSign/evidence-exchange instead of Drive, say the word and we’ll switch. Also setting up the Slack channel now: #helixpay-redwood-evidence (invites incoming).
